import sys, random
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('entry','/app/submission/entry.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
Store = m.Store

class Ref:
    def __init__(self): self.d = {}
    def conflicts(self, off, data):
        for i,b in enumerate(data):
            o = off+i
            if o in self.d and self.d[o] != b: return True
        return False
    def store(self, off, data, keep):
        for i,b in enumerate(data):
            o = off+i
            if o in self.d and keep: continue
            self.d[o] = b
    def prefix(self):
        out = bytearray(); i=0
        while i in self.d:
            out.append(self.d[i]); i+=1
        return bytes(out)

random.seed(1234)
for trial in range(500):
    rs = Store(); rr = Ref()
    keep = (trial % 2 == 0)
    for step in range(80):
        n = random.randint(0, 12)
        off = random.choice([0,1,127,128,129,255,256,random.randint(0,400)]) if random.random()<0.4 else random.randint(0,10**18)
        data = bytes(random.randint(0,255) for _ in range(n))
        c1 = rs.conflicts(off, data); c2 = rr.conflicts(off, data)
        assert c1==c2, ('conflict', off, data.hex())
        if not c1 or not keep:
            rs.store(off, data, None, keep); rr.store(off, data, keep)
        assert rs.prefix() == rr.prefix(), ('prefix', off, data.hex())
        # rollback integrity
        j = m.Journal(None)
        snap = dict((k,(bytes(v[0]),v[1])) for k,v in rs.blocks.items())
        d2 = bytes(random.randint(0,255) for _ in range(random.randint(1,20)))
        o2 = random.randint(0,10**18)
        rs.store(o2, d2, j, keep)
        j.rollback()
        after = dict((k,(bytes(v[0]),v[1])) for k,v in rs.blocks.items())
        assert snap == after, ('rollback state', off, data.hex())
        assert rs.prefix() == rr.prefix()
print('store tests OK')
EOF
